title: Why Isolate?
prompt: Write needs_venv(python_a, req_a, python_b, req_b) that returns True when two projects on one machine would CONFLICT — i.e. they share a package name but need different versions.

tests.name: conflict detection
tests.code:
assert needs_venv("requests==2.25", ["requests==2.25"], "requests==2.31", ["requests==2.31"]) is True, "same package, different versions -> conflict"
assert needs_venv("rich", ["rich==13.7"], "rich", ["rich==13.7"]) is False, "identical pins -> no conflict"
tests.hint: compare the version part after == for any shared package name.
